annotations.title: Prepare Midnight Supply Collateral Take Borrow

description: Prepare supplying collateral and a fixed-rate borrow on a Midnight market in one MidnightBundlesV2 transaction, taking the best bid offers. First call `morpho_midnight_get_market` for the collateral index and tokens, and `morpho_midnight_get_book_quote` with side `bids` and the same amount. Returns unsigned transactions, approval and MidnightBundlesV2 authorization first, plus a simulation and warnings.

amount.description: Loan token amount to receive, in human-readable decimals (e.g. "100")

collateralAmount.description: Collateral token amount to supply, in human-readable decimals

collateralIndex.description: Index of the collateral in the market `collaterals` list

marketId.description: Midnight market ID (`market_id` from the Midnight read tools)

slippage.description: Slippage percentage applied to the book quote (e.g. "0.5" = 0.5%). Bounds the units filled at the quoted average price.

userAddress.description: Account that sends the transactions and owns the position

name: morpho_prepare_midnight_supply_collateral_take_borrow
